I have enough to judge each requirement from the code. Let me summarize the key findings:

**Backend** (`server.js`, `store.js`, `metadata.js`): CRUD for bookmarks + `fetch-details`. Metadata extraction only pulls `title`, `description`, `site_name` — **no favicon, no preview/og:image**. No snapshot, no import/export, no bundles, no settings, no sort endpoint.

**Frontend** (`app.js`, `index.html`, `search.js`, `urlkey.js`): Single page. Views: All / Read later / Archived. Search engine supports full-text (title/desc/note/url/tags), case-insensitive, `#tag`, AND/OR/NOT + parens, quoted phrases. Duplicate URL converges to edit via `findExisting`. Note shown as escaped plain text (no markdown render). No tag autocomplete, no clickable tag filter (only via `#tag` search), no multi-select/bulk actions, no sort control, no settings.
